components.name: Alphabet rail
components.description: Illustrative native translation. Schematic short-window rail showing available Latin sections and a final hash. Cyrillic initials use the first Latin letter of Android ICU Russian-Latin/BGN transliteration, including Яндекс → Yandeks → Y; numbers, symbols and initials without Latin transliteration use #. Below the letters, an active release selects the final section even without a final MOVE; cancelled gestures stay cancelled. Runtime is one continuous accessible control with finger-following Canvas geometry, not individual letter buttons.

narrative.overview:
The user selected Niagara's vertical favorites and alphabetical navigation. The current implementation expresses that direction through native Android Views: an open wallpaper surface, white app names, installed app icons, a continuous alphabet control, and dark native sheets. Better Launcher uses original Kotlin source under its own product name and displays the system wallpaper.

Settings use a warm dark Material 3 theme, while the launcher itself stays visually open. This document describes the implemented phone UI, not verified Niagara fidelity or full feature parity. The native source is authoritative: [MainActivity.kt](app/src/main/java/app/better/launcher/MainActivity.kt), [LauncherViews.kt](app/src/main/java/app/better/launcher/LauncherViews.kt), and [styles.xml](app/src/main/res/values/styles.xml). Review captures are stored locally in `.impeccable/review/`; the historical five material corrections for 0.1.0 have a scoped `ship` verdict in [verification.md](docs/verification.md).
keyCharacteristics: Unboxed app lists over the system wallpaper.
White foreground with warm secondary text and restrained peach settings accents.
Native controls, content-driven row heights, and persistent bottom actions.
A continuous alphabet rail with touch, keyboard, and accessibility alternatives.

rules.name: The Readable Wallpaper Rule
rules.body: A native Material slider controls black scrim opacity from 0% (fully visible wallpaper) to 100% (black background), in 1% steps. The default is 20%, with no mandatory contrast floor. The inline percentage updates and saves immediately; the slider supports keyboard and accessibility input. Lower dimming can reduce white-text contrast on bright wallpapers. Legacy enabled dimming maps to 20%, disabled dimming to 0%; an explicitly saved percentage takes precedence.

rules.name: The Grow With Text Rule
rules.body: App and settings rows use minimum heights, not fixed text containers; preserve wrapping when Android font scale grows. The fixed footer remains outside the scrolling home content. App results use a native ListView that recycles visible rows with content-driven heights.

rules.name: The Separate Footer Rule
rules.body: Keep bottom navigation outside the scrolling favorite list so long lists and larger text cannot cover its actions.

rules.name: The Open List Rule
rules.body: Keep launcher app rows unboxed at rest; reserve opaque containers for sheets, settings, notification detail, and transient feedback, as the current build does.

rules.name: The Separate Widget Page Rule
rules.body: Home hosts at most one widget. The separate wallpaper-backed page to its left opens with a rightward swipe on free home space or the footer widget button and returns with a leftward swipe, Home, or Android Back. App rows and hosted widget content keep their gestures; the outer 24dp Back edge is reserved. The page hides the alphabet, uses a wrapping 26sp header, 28dp list margins, 24dp widget gaps, and a separate Home footer. Labels grow from 48dp minimum height. A 180ms directional slide/fade honors disabled system animations. The alphabet reserves system/IME insets and the measured home footer height, preserving footer touch targets at large font sizes.

rules.name: The Favorites Order Rule
rules.body: Use one saved order for apps and folders. Keep the sheet heading and bottom actions outside its recycled scrolling list; wrap names above a separate 48dp action line. Drag handles and labeled arrow alternatives save immediately without dismissing the editor or resetting scroll. Retain unavailable app/profile IDs. At screen widths of at least 600dp, place row actions inline to fit more items in short landscape windows.

dos: **Do** preserve the user's Niagara-style vertical lists and alphabetical navigation.
**Do** keep app rows transparent and use installed app icons and actual system data.
**Do** respect the selected wallpaper dimming percentage and retain warm secondary text.
**Do** keep scrolling home content separate from persistent footer actions.
**Do** let text rows grow with font scale and preserve keyboard and accessibility alternatives.
**Do** use native Material 3 controls within the existing dark theme.
donts: **Don't** replace the selected launcher composition with a card grid or a new brand metaphor.
**Don't** copy the raw ripple-mask radius as a density-aware spacing or shape token.
**Don't** treat panel CSS samples or synthesized tonal ramps as Android source values.
**Don't** claim exact Niagara fidelity, full feature parity, tablet support, or physical-device validation from this phone build.
